decisions.reason: The Magento shop template is adjacent to our e-commerce hosting business but remains a niche, maintenance-heavy product that is less strategic than core hosting, support, and platform tools.
The responsive website template still complements agency and freelancer projects, although its generic and non-core nature means withdrawal risk is not low.
Premium customer support is central to our managed-service positioning and a key reason customers choose us, so discontinuation is very unlikely.
The software version management tool builds directly on our technical know-how and supports customer retention in the hosting and administration business.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship offer tightly aligned with our strategy, customer base, and ongoing platform investment, so we should retain it.
